name: a-cold-row-in-another-profile-opens-in-its-row
description: A cold row in a space of another profile opens its page in that row. The recorded bug: each click on the cold row opened the page again and added a new row, and the clicked row stayed cold. Alpha belongs to the Default profile and Bravo to the Second profile. The app starts on Alpha, moves to Bravo and clicks Bravo's cold row two times.

actions.note: gate: the app is up on Alpha's own tab
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
into Bravo's space, which belongs to the Second profile

actions.expression: (() => { const rs = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane[data-space-index="1"] [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; return rs.length + ' rows, cold ' + rs.filter((x) => (x.dataset.url || '').endsWith('?cold')).map((x) => x.dataset.tabId ? 'live' : 'cold').join('+'); })()

(() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane[data-space-index="1"] [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')].find((x) => (x.dataset.url || '').endsWith('?cold')); if (!r) { return 'no-cold-row'; } const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(b.left + 60) + ',' + Math.round((b.top + b.bottom) / 2 + 30); })()
